profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: A passionate software engineer with 15+ years background in full stack and mobile development working at top tech companies, including Google and Amazon. Highly organized and goal oriented, equally successful working in large teams and as an individual contributor. Committed to a high bar in the development process, leading the design and engineering best practices and standards. Working to deliver results and driving a long-term vision and how it fits into a bigger architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented and launched support for managing multiple books on the Android client in the user library, including batch processing operations on the backend. The feature was well accepted by users, got positive reviews in the Play Store increasing app rating and customer satisfaction.
• Led an effort of redesigning in app pages for series purchases from early design to feature landing, resulting in single digit revenue increase after launch in purchases of bundled series volumes.
• Owned Android client metrics domain, coaching team members and collaborating with cross product area teams on best practices in app health monitoring, providing key metrics for more precise experiment evaluation and reducing time to ramp up features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led asset capitalization team in Capacity Planning, working on internal management portal and backend processing workflows for performing financial capitalization of assets in Google datacenters for regulatory compliance.
• Landed companywide (60+ teams) Oracle to SAP migration on behalf of capitalization team, ensured success of all major testing phases. After landing the migration, owned, and led system transition of team the projects after company’s reorg to a new onboarding team in Mountain View.
• Owned implementation, launch and migration strategy of asset capitalization service that replaced the previous capitalization process for Google Finance team, significantly reduced operational toil of engineering and finance support (from 2 weeks to 2 hours every month) and increased process visibility providing capitalization reports.
• Managed a team of external contractors working on web UI and reporting portals for the capitalization service.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented internationalization tooling and framework used across multiple products and services within the company (from retail website to Kindle devices), unblocking launches of Amazon products in international marketplaces, such as India.
• Conducted integration of International Components for Unicode into Amazon build system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented order processing workflow using microservices for company’s retail website.
• Integrated the company’s order management system with shipping provider ConnectShip, that replaced the old shipping provider.

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented subscription-based product purchase services, frontend, and backend components (role-based encryption certificate management system, back-office UI components for service and account management, data processing micro services). The system became the foundation of the company’s current product distribution.
• Owned reporting system implemented using SSRS and SSIS workflows for company’s data warehouse storage, providing finance department with monthly billing reports.
• Led the team as a scrum master for agile development and planning processes and mentored junior developers.

positions.title: Senior .Net Developer
positions.description:
• Designed components for the company’s CRM and ERP systems to manage parcels tracking from shipping providers and delivery courier terminals, successfully launched integration with two shipping providers.
• Integrated multiple shipping client company APIs into the company’s CRM to expand range of shipping providers and provide more shipping options.
• Developed SSRS business reports and SSIS workflows for reporting processing for finance department
• Mentored junior developers, administered development process.

positions.title: Senior .Net Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented internal vulnerability reporting web application. The system gathered public and private vulnerability database sources and validated current state and updates of internal bank machines and servers against it, reporting potential threats and vulnerable elements.
• Integrated current system into bank’s SSO and enriched with various data presentation plugins.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented vulnerability monitoring web application for Kaspersky Lab. The system performed real time monitoring of client infrastructure and scanned fingerprints of components against known vulnerabilities to surface potential threats.
• Designed and implemented annual KPI reporting system for OMK bank management department. 
• Developed modules and plugins for online service desk system Intraservice (http://www.intraservice.ru/).
• Developed airplane and railway tickets booking system for Teletrain (http://www.teletrain.ru/).

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Developed company s eCommerce website and CRM for automatization of ordering car parts for sales department.

positions.title: ETL Developer
positions.description: Consulted company clients and developed custom solutions for them using Informatica Power Center and Informatica Data Quality products.

educations.schoolName: Tomsk State University of Control Systems and Radioelectronics
